summary: Phase 149O.14 -- HATP AG3/AG5 Mandatory Production Consumption Architecture: architecture-only phase, zero src/pcae/** or docs/contracts/** changes. Ran the required initial inspection (git status/branch/log/rev-list, pcae health/check/status coherence/doctor task-memory/push check/runtime inspect, telegram notify status, phase-report show --latest and reconcile --phase-id 149O.13) and confirmed the expected baseline: repo clean, 149O.13 completed/complete/pushed, HSCE-001 v1.1 unchanged, HATP production NOT READY, runtime Observed/observe/unavailable. Read HSCE-001 v1.1 in full directly (not summarized), and the complete production source of the AG3/AG5 dispatch paths, the HATP evidence store, the gated authority adapter, and the Permission Broker foundation. Directly reconstructed, by source inspection rather than by trusting prior phase-report summaries, the exact current AG3 call graph (pcae remote rollback execute -> run_remote_rollback_execute -> execute_rollback, real dispatch gated only by legacy rollback_approval_state == 'approved', real effect _run_git_revert) and AG5 call graph (pcae rollback --per-id -> run_rollback -> build_rollback_execution, real dispatch gated only by PER-status/divergence/payload-availability structural checks -- AG5 has no human-approval gate at all today -- real effect a file write/unlink loop), confirming the pre-existing 149O.6 Wave-7 hatp_evidence_id/hatp_proof/hatp_evidence hooks on both functions remain inert (zero kwargs passed) on every real production call site, by direct AST inspection of the actual CLI-handler call sites. Reconstructed HATPEvidenceStore.load(evidence_id) as explicit-ID-only, no verification, no approval derivation. Reconstructed hatp_ag_authority's gated AG3/AG5 authority-derivation functions and confirmed they do not currently call the evidence store's .load() at all -- the exact seam this architecture closes. Investigated, rather than assumed, whether current real AG3/AG5 effects are gated by Permission Broker/COMP-002: traced actual _run_git_revert and the AG5 file-write/unlink call points directly and found they are gated only by the legacy/structural preconditions above, not by PB or any execution-capability check -- honestly documented as an existing architectural inconsistency this phase does not attempt to close beyond defining the human-approval-source boundary, distinct from the separate, deferred COMP-002 execution-enforcement track. Selected one target architecture (effect-boundary mandatory adapter) against three evaluated and rejected alternatives (CLI-level-only verification: rejected, direct-call bypass; persistent approval-state conversion: rejected, cached/stale-approval and revocation problems; command-session capability token: not applicable, no existing architecture support) -- justified from direct source, not asserted. Selected architecture properties: explicit --hatp-evidence-id <id> locator only on both pcae remote rollback execute (AG3) and pcae rollback --per-id (AG5), with no raw-proof/evidence-file/provider/trust-store/approval-boolean flags of any kind; internal-only HATPEvidenceStore.load(evidence_id) -> HATPSignedEvidenceEnvelope resolution, never a caller-supplied envelope or raw proof on the mandatory path; fresh consumption-time verification on every single attempt, with no cache of verification status, approval_present, or PB decision anywhere; reuse (unmodified, not duplicated) of the existing gated RAE/HATP approval-derivation engine; Permission Broker remaining the sole permission-decision owner, with approval_present treated strictly as an input fact, never itself a decision, and PB HUMAN_REVIEW/DENY still blocking dispatch even given valid HATP evidence; the mandatory gate placed inside execute_rollback/build_rollback_execution themselves immediately ahead of the real effect call, covering CLI and any direct-function caller identically (no CLI-only bypass); legacy pcae remote rollback approve retaining its current behavior pre-cutover and returning a deterministic, non-mutating deprecation error post-cutover (never silently mutating rollback_approval_state once mandatory mode applies, no OR-condition dual authority ever); rollback_approval_state remaining authoritative pre-cutover and becoming migration-compatibility/historical metadata only post-cutover; every existing AG5 PER-status/divergence/payload check classified as a structural safety precondition unaffected by cutover (AG5 gains a human-approval gate for the first time under this design, since it has none today); and a protected, one-way LEGACY_COMPATIBLE -> PREPARED -> HATP_MANDATORY cutover state machine triggered only by Class-B protected admin authority, stored in Class-B protected storage (never agent-writable .pcae/), with no --legacy/--skip-hatp/env-var override of any kind, and with the current developer host defaulting to and remaining in LEGACY_COMPATIBLE unless a genuine protected-activation event occurs. Defined fail-closed semantics for every evidence failure mode (missing, corrupt, digest-mismatch, unsupported-version, expired, revoked-signer, wrong-operation, cross-family AG3/AG5, wrong-repository, wrong-deployment, Decision/Binding replay) post-cutover, with no legacy fallback under any condition, reusing existing HATP operation-binding/repository-identity/digest-check machinery rather than designing new binding logic. Defined that pending legacy approvals at cutover are not grandfathered and require fresh signed evidence post-cutover. Authored the full architecture document (docs/PHASE_149O_14_HATP_AG3_AG5_MANDATORY_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_ARCHITECTURE.md) including the current-state baseline, both call graphs, the architecture-alternatives evaluation, the selected target architecture, a 45-scenario future mandatory-consumption attack matrix, MC-1..MC-13 security invariants, a threat-model section, a B-149O-1..4-to-target-path mapping, an explicit disposition for each of 149O.13's non-blocking findings, and a full architecture-traceability table (concern / current implementation / target architecture / owning future contract / future production owner / verification obligation). Authored a new architecture-verification test file (tests/test_phase_149o_14_hatp_ag3_ag5_mandatory_production_consumption_architecture.py, 30 tests, all passing) that independently confirms, via direct AST/grep/import inspection rather than prose assertion, every current-state factual claim the architecture document depends on: the AG3/AG5 call-graph facts, the additive/non-gating placement of the Wave-7 HATP block relative to each function's real dispatch gate, that real production callers pass zero HATP kwargs, the evidence store's explicit-ID-only load() shape, that hatp_ag_authority never currently calls .load() and still accepts no provider/trust-store override (F-2 closure intact), that pcae hatp sign rollback is registered and functional, that no --hatp-evidence-id flag exists yet on either rollback CLI surface, that legacy approve remains unconditional and HATP-unaware today, that PB's POL-005/execution_unavailable machinery is present and the gated-authority adapter's own PB call is simulation_only, that no COMP-002 module exists, and that no production source file was modified this phase. VERDICT: HATP AG3/AG5 MANDATORY PRODUCTION CONSUMPTION ARCHITECTURE: SELECTED. B-149O-1..4 remain INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED AT HATP-GATED AUTHORITY BOUNDARY -- SYSTEM EXECUTION CLOSURE DEFERRED, not closed by this phase. HATP production remains NOT READY. Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_14_HATP_AG3_AG5_MANDATORY_PRODUCTION_CONSUMPTION_ARCHITECTURE.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.15 -- HATP Mandatory Production Consumption Contract Freeze.
